# rapsimng.wheat

Wheat model for APSIM Next Generation.

## Installation

Currently on [Github](https://github.com/byzheng/rapsimng.wheat) only.
Install with:

``` r

remotes::install_github('byzheng/rapsimng.wheat')
```

## Documentation

For detailed documentation and reference, visit:
<https://wheat.rapsimng.bangyou.me>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Package index

## All functions

- [`thermal_time()`](https://wheat.rapsimng.bangyou.me/reference/thermal_time.md)
  : Calculate thermal time using cardinal temperatures
- [`wheat`](https://wheat.rapsimng.bangyou.me/reference/wheat.md) :
  Wheat model options manager
